game_title: Reverse Countdown – Hollow Log Trail Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round, a new moss bundles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 490 points of moss bundles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 490, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed treants in Hollow Log Trail.
